description: This file defines a `HomeFragment` class for an Android TV application, utilizing the Leanback library to create a browse-style interface with a top navigation bar, background management, and content rows with focus handling.

classes.name: HomeFragment
classes.description: A Fragment that provides a TV-optimized browsing interface with background management, top navigation, and content rows.

classes.name: CardItem
classes.description: Data model representing individual media content cards.

classes.name: HeroCardPresenter
classes.description: A custom presenter for displaying media cards with focus scaling and info overlays.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the fragment, prepares the background, sets up UI, and builds content rows.

methods.name: prepareBackground
methods.description: Sets up the background manager with a placeholder drawable.

methods.name: setupUI
methods.description: Configures the UI, including headers and title view.

methods.name: buildTopNavBar
methods.description: Builds the top navigation bar with labels.

methods.name: setTitlePaddingForTV
methods.description: Adjusts padding for TV display for better overscan safety.

methods.name: buildRows
methods.description: Constructs the content rows for 'Seguí viendo' and 'Canales de TV'.

methods.name: buildCardRow
methods.description: Creates a content row with a header and list of CardItems.

methods.name: sampleItems
methods.description: Generates sample CardItems for display in rows.

methods.name: onItemClicked
methods.description: Handles item click events (currently a placeholder).

methods.name: onItemSelected
methods.description: Updates the background image when a different item is selected.
